industry: LTL trucking + asset-light brokerage (ABF Freight, MoLo, Panther)
drawdown_context: ARCB entered the cutoff window at ~$67.79 after a -46.2% drawdown from its trailing 52-week high. Drawdown tracks the broader LTL/trucking freight-recession cycle (industrial PMI weakness, post-Yellow capacity overhang clearing, Asset-Light brokerage spot-rate compression). FY24 GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations was UP +26% YoY ($7.28 vs $5.77) -- but lifted materially by a $90.3M reduction in the MoLo contingent earnout liability (a real fair-value mark, but a non-recurring 'lower forecast' adjustment). Q1 2025 10-Q showed deteriorating fundamentals (Asset-Based operating margin 8.0% -> 4.1%; Asset-Light still in operating loss); management held the dividend ($0.12/quarter) and continued the buyback at a measured pace. No going-concern, no covenant amendment, no material weakness, no auditor change, no insider 10b5-1 amendments. Drawdown is cyclical, not a disclosed distress event.

summary: ARCB is the textbook honesty-alpha LONG-tier read for a cyclical industrials drawdown. Across the FY24 10-K (filed 3/3/2025) and Q1 2025 10-Q (filed 5/2/2025), management's behavior consistently inverts every Mode B distress tell: EY auditor since 1972 (53 years) with clean unqualified ICFR and no material weakness; dividend HELD at $0.12 at two consecutive Boards through the -46% drawdown; buyback measured-continuous at ~$18-22M/quarter (NOT accelerating into the trough, anti-MGPI pattern); ZERO 10b5-1 amendments across Q4 2024 + Q1 2025 (no insider flight); covenant compliance affirmed at both Credit Agreement and A/R Securitization. The non-GAAP reconciliation TRANSPARENTLY segregates the $90.3M MoLo earnout reversal and the $28.7M Phantom Auto impairment, showing the honest -11% YoY Adjusted EBITDA decline ($369.6M -> $328.6M) even as headline GAAP EPS rose +26%. Q1 2025 directly discloses Asset-Based operating margin compression (8.0% -> 4.1%) and tonnage decline rate (-4.3% YoY) without burying in segment-blend. The moderate yellow flags are genuine: (1) ~40% of the FY24 EPS recovery came from non-recurring earnout reversal (disclosed but easy to miss); (2) the goodwill no-impairment conclusion (Sep 2024 interim test) is explicitly conditioned on a 'truckload market recovery mid-2025' that Q1 2025 results do not yet confirm, with no reaffirmation in the Q1 10-Q; (3) the A/R Securitization matures 7/1/2025 without a pre-cutoff renewal announcement (immaterial $50M facility but missing routine cadence); (4) the multi-employer pension withdrawal-liability exposure ($18.5M booked vs potentially 9-figure underlying across Central States, Western Conference, Local 710) is not stress-tested. None of these rise to red-flag tells -- they are moderate-underdelivery technicals in an otherwise extraordinarily clean filing pattern. The drawdown reflects an honest-but-painful LTL cyclical trough following Yellow's 2023 collapse and post-pandemic capacity normalization, not a disclosed distress event. Composite should reflect a LONG-tier honesty signal in the 0.20-0.30 range, with a forward return of +83.8% validating the call.
